name: Lavender enhydro amethyst
label: Three fluid inclusions
summary: Three reported moving bubbles inside pale lavender quartz, revealed through broad polished faces.
description: Three small pockets of fluid make this lavender amethyst especially distinctive. The owner reports a moving bubble in each. Quartz can trap fluid during growth or when fractures heal; polishing gives a clear view of what remains inside. A favourite retained in the private collection.
highlights: Pale lavender colour with deeper purple zones
Three moving bubbles, reported by the owner
Polished faces that reveal the interior
formation: In quartz, a pocket of fluid may be enclosed as the crystal grows or as a fracture heals. A gas bubble within that fluid can move when the specimen is tilted. The trade calls these pieces “enhydro” quartz or amethyst.
finishing: The polished faces make the interior easier to inspect. This photograph cannot show movement, and the fluid’s age has not been established. The owner’s caption describes three moving inclusions and marks the piece not for sale.
